name: Paras
description: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: The user attacks by draining the target’s nutrients. Some of the damage dealt to the target is absorbed by the user to restore their own HP.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of toxic powder that poisons the target.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid to inflict damage. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a burst of spores that makes the target drowsy.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user strikes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.
